normalization_contract.lbc_format: positive integer, missing/invalid counted as invalid_lbc_count
normalization_contract.dedup_rule: first valid record per stock_code kept
normalization_contract.hash_input: deterministic JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8)

pairs.selection_rule: latest (Tue-Fri) adjacent trading days before review date

promotion_rates.identity_match_basis: stock_code identity over normalized rows (round1); lbc N -> N+1 required for numerator
promotion_rates.denominator_contract: denominator_N = count of unique legal stock_code in previous_normalized_rows where lbc == N (includes missing_current codes; does not depend on current pool presence)
promotion_rates.numerator_contract: numerator_N = among the above denominator codes, count where the same stock_code appears in current_normalized_rows with lbc == N + 1
